metadata.question: Does the land covered by lava flows increase in the Todoque and El Paraíso areas of La Palma between May 21, 2021 and December 15, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Todoque and El Paraíso areas of La Palma (Canary Islands, Spain) - Dates: May 21, 2021 vs December 15, 2021 - Collection: Sentinel-2 for high-resolution optical imagery to detect lava flows - Note: The Cumbre Vieja volcano erupted in La Palma from September 19 to December 13, 2021 2. Masking strategy: - Apply cloud masking to get clear views - Use indices like NBR (Normalized Burn Ratio) or SWIR bands to detect lava flows - Lava flows appear dark in NIR and bright in SWIR 3. Logic: - Compare lava area between the two dates - Valid zero (no lava) at first date is expected (pre-eruption) - Increase in lava area = Answer A - No increase = Answer B - Handle C1 (no images), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (calculation failure) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define area of interest - Todoque and El Paraíso, La Palma const todoque = ee.Geometry.Point([-17.891, 28.615]); const elParaiso = ee.Geometry.Point([-17.888, 28.620]); const aoi = ee.Geometry.MultiPoint([todoque, elParaiso]).buffer(2000); // 2. Cloud masking function function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(cloudMask); } // 3. Function to detect lava using spectral indices function detectLava(image) { const nir = image.select('B8'); const swir2 = image.select('B12'); const nbr = nir.subtract(swir2).divide(nir.add(swir2)); // Lava has very low NBR values (< -0.3) const lava = nbr.lt(-0.25); return lava.rename('lava'); } // 4. Get imagery for May 21, 2021 const date1Start = '2021-05-15'; const date1End = '2021-05-27'; let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate(date1Start, date1End) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); const size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); console.log(`May 2021 Images: ${size1}`); if (size1 === 0) { console.log('No images for May 2021'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Get imagery for December 15, 2021 const date2Start = '2021-12-10'; const date2End = '2021-12-20'; let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate(date2Start, date2End) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); const size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`December 2021 Images: ${size2}`); if (size2 === 0) { console.log('No images for December 2021'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 6. Process May 2021 const img1 = col1.map(maskClouds).median(); const lava1 = detectLava(img1); const stats1 = await lava1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: aoi, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const lavaArea1 = stats1.lava_sum || 0; const validPixels1 = stats1.lava_count || 0; console.log(`May 2021 - Valid pixels: ${validPixels1}, Lava pixels: ${lavaArea1}`); if (validPixels1 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for May 2021'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 7. Process December 2021 const img2 = col2.map(maskClouds).median(); const lava2 = detectLava(img2); const stats2 = await lava2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: aoi, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const lavaArea2 = stats2.lava_sum || 0; const validPixels2 = stats2.lava_count || 0; console.log(`Dec 2021 - Valid pixels: ${validPixels2}, Lava pixels: ${lavaArea2}`); if (validPixels2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for December 2021'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 8. Calculate change const increase = lavaArea2 - lavaArea1; console.log(`Lava pixel increase: ${increase}`); console.log(`Lava area increase (hectares): ${(increase * 100 * 100 / 10000).toFixed(2)}`); // 9. Final answer if (increase > 100) { // Significant increase (>1 hectare) console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
